mix: a short 5-6 day trip just to Fairy Meadows and Nanga Parbat base camp, trips that add Hunza, and long routes that carry on to Rupal, Deosai and Skardu

day_groups.label: 5-6 days
day_groups.why: Fairy Meadows and the Nanga Parbat base camp walk, with a long drive each way from Islamabad.

day_groups.label: 9-11 days
day_groups.why: Fairy Meadows plus Hunza: Karimabad, Upper Hunza and usually Khunjerab.

day_groups.label: 14 days or more
day_groups.why: Fairy Meadows as part of a grand loop through Astore, Rupal, Deosai and Skardu.

days_tip: Whatever you book, the jeep track from Raikot Bridge is the hard part - don't do it in rain or after dark, and keep a spare day for weather.
notes: UK travel advice (FCDO) warns against all travel on the KKH between Mansehra and Chilas. In summer the Babusar road (open roughly late May to October) avoids that stretch - check which route your trip uses.

packages.name: Fairy Meadows 5-Day Tour
packages.best: The shortest trip, with the jeep included
itinerary: Early start from Islamabad to Chilas, over Babusar Top when it's open.
Jeep from Raikot Bridge to Tato, then hike up to Fairy Meadows.
A full day at Fairy Meadows, with an optional hike to Nanga Parbat base camp.
Hike down, jeep back to Raikot Bridge and drive to Chilas (or Naran).
Back to Islamabad, continuing to Lahore for those heading south.
good: Gilgit-based operator that says it focuses on sustainable tourism
Jeep charges are listed as included
watch: Priced in US dollars for groups of 8-12 - ask about a private or local rate

packages.name: Fairy Meadows Adventure
packages.best: Fairy Meadows at an easy pace, full board

Through the Kaghan Valley and over Babusar Pass (if open) to Chilas.
Raikot Bridge, jeep to Tato and the walk up to Fairy Meadows.
Hike to Nanga Parbat base camp and back.
Down to Raikot Bridge and on to Besham or Naran.
Taxila, Islamabad and departure.

Full board, with drive times and altitudes listed for every day
watch: Two long road days each way

packages.best: Fairy Meadows plus Hunza in ten days

Up the KKH to Chilas, stopping at the Shatial rock carvings.
Jeep from Raikot Bridge and hike up to Fairy Meadows.
Hike to Nanga Parbat base camp and back.
Down from Fairy Meadows and on to Karimabad, Hunza.
Baltit and Altit forts, then via Hopper to Gulmit.
Passu Glacier, Borith Lake and the suspension bridges.

packages.name: Nanga Parbat & Fairy Meadows
packages.best: Hiking beyond the meadow to Beyal camp
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad; city sightseeing.
Long drive (about 12 hours) to Raikot Bridge.
Jeep from Raikot Bridge to Tato, then up to Fairy Meadows.
Hike on to Beyal camp (5-6 hours).
Hike back down to Tato and jeep to Raikot Bridge.
Drive to Hunza.
Passu Cones, the Hussaini suspension bridge, a walk on Batura Glacier and Attabad Lake.
Long drive back to Islamabad.
Departure.
good: Goes past the meadow to Beyal for closer Nanga Parbat views
watch: Listed as 10 days, but the day plan runs 9 - confirm
Hunza to Islamabad in one day is a very long drive

Hike to Nanga Parbat base camp and back.
Down from Fairy Meadows and on to Upper Hunza (Ghulkin, Passu or Gulmit).
Khunjerab Pass.
Ghulkin, Passu and Gulmit villages.

Karimabad and central Hunza's heritage sites.
South via the KKH or Babusar Pass to Besham or Naran.
Taxila and an Islamabad city tour.

packages.name: Fairy Meadow Tour (with Rupal, Deosai and Skardu)

Drive to Naran.

Khaplu to Shigar.
Shigar to Skardu.

Baltit Fort, Hopper and Attabad Lake, then on to Gulmit.

Taxila and Islamabad.
